name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc40): the tools now check that a record they opened by its key is the record that was asked for, before they write to it. On a screen that the site map sets to the Classic UI the open could load a different record, and the change was saved there; found on Row Sets (CS206010) on 2026R1. If the wrong record loads, the tools now ask again the way the browser's Modern UI does, and stop with nothing written if it is still the wrong one. With that, Row Sets on 2026R1 can be edited through the tools: a row's account range, style and description, adding and deleting rows, and creating, copying and deleting a row set. Saving on that screen renumbers the row codes; see the changelog. From this version the server program is downloaded from a GitHub release of this repository instead of PyPI; you update the plugin the same way as before. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
